scoring.formula: Score_t(c) = W_base(c) - alpha * Visits_W(c, H_t) + beta * I[is_seam(c)] * max(0, N_in_family(H_t) - N_threshold + 1)
scoring.W_base: Tier-1 candidates use weights_numerator[target Chaldean degree]; every cross-family seam candidate uses W_seam_base
scoring.Visits_W: count of occurrences of candidate mask@phase in the last W states of H_t, inclusive of the current state
scoring.N_in_family: number of consecutive prior states ending at s_t whose (governingRoot, phase) equals the current (governingRoot, phase)
scoring.is_seam: candidate category is familyA-seam or familyB-seam

parameter_justification.note: W_seam_base + beta = 120 > 116 guarantees a licensed seam reaches presented_index 0 at N_in_family = N_threshold; beta = 50 would yield 100 and leave Tier-1 candidates ahead.

fence: The card ranks already-legal candidates; it never alters a gate verdict.
